title: Can I BEAT TINY 5D Chess?
summary: Tiny variant of 5D Chess With Multiverse Time Travel on 4x4 boards; moves can travel back in time creating new timelines.
rules: Each board is 4x4; each side: K, R, B, N + 4 pawns (frame).
Pieces move as in chess within a board, and can also move through time (back to earlier boards) and across timelines along the same axes.
Moving to a past board creates a new timeline branch.
Player must make a move on every active present board then press Submit Moves.
win_condition: Checkmate across the multiverse (king attacked on any board with no escape).

board.theme_notes: tan/cream boards on light blue-grey background, purple time arrows

setup: 4x4 per board: back rank K R B N (Black mirrored), pawns on second rank.
evidence: Frame line: 4x4 boards, timelines, Submit Moves. Time-travel rules from game knowledge.
